audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Renekton six of seven stages including first item and 2+ items, while diff is already FAV at 54.55% and the file itself says 'Renekton has no scaling to reclaim the late game'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Renekton / Renekton / Renekton / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle. He is a pure early bully; the item stages are exactly where Kayle takes over, and the prose in whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] already says so.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 -> Kayle; rows 0-2 stay Renekton. Flipped in matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly sited: Renekton levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Kayle 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two omissions and one misstatement. Omitted: Ruthless Predator resets his auto-attack, and its empowered version destroys damage shields and stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Misstated: Starfire Spellblade is twice called 'percent-HP' damage when Riot's text says damage proportionate to MISSING health. No cooldown appears anywhere despite the packet flagging it.
audit.why: Against a fury-empowered combo the auto reset is the real burst tell — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step out. The missing-health distinction matters because it tells you to finish him, not to open on him. Numbers: Cull the Meek flat 7s, Ruthless Predator 16/14/12/10/8s, Slice and Dice 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Dominus 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: State the auto reset and 1.5s empowered stun with shield-break, correct the E damage to missing-health, and write the 16s W window in as the punish trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cull the Meek heals him on a flat 7s cooldown and more when fury-empowered, but Grievous Wounds is only mentioned in the itemization report line — never in the lane prose where the trade decision is made.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal: his sustain is what makes extended trades unwinnable, so anti-heal timing is the trade rule, not an item footnote.
audit.corrected: Executioner's named in whys[5] as the thing that stops the Q heal undoing your kite damage.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing and Radiant Blast's resist shred hold the edges; punish the 16s window after his empowered W and bank the farm lead.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Renekton's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and Divine Judgment eats the whole E-W-Q fury combo — once both Slice and Dice charges are spent he cannot follow.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ruthless Predator's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's lands and ranged E on-hits bully a Renekton whose fury combo is already falling off.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Renekton carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He has no scaling left to reclaim the lane — at full build every all-in he commits gets blanked and answered.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Survive it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — 16/14/12/10/8s; empowered it stuns 1.5s, breaks shields and resets his auto. - Slice and Dice: 10-16s, and both halves spent means no gap-close. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empowered W stuns for 1.5s, breaks shields and resets his auto.

edits.before: Full ranged DPS kites his Slice-and-Dice combo from outside his reach and percent-HP E waves melt him — he can't close the gap to retaliate.
edits.after: Ranged DPS kites Slice and Dice from outside his reach and missing-health E waves melt him — hold Executioner's so Cull the Meek can't heal it back.

edits.before: Full ranged DPS: you kite his E-W-Q combo from outside his reach, melt him with percent-HP E waves, and R blanks any all-in he commits to.
edits.after: Full ranged DPS: you kite his E-W-Q combo from outside his reach, melt him with missing-health E waves, and R blanks any all-in he commits to.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are the scariest part of this lane and you simply lose them. Renekton dashes in with E (Slice and Dice), lands his W (Ruthless Predator) stun, and fury-empowers his Q to heal back anything you chip — your short melee autos and single point of W heal can't trade into that. Do not contest CS inside his range; last-hit at the edge of your Q (Radiant Blast) so you can still self-armor-shred for poke, use W only to top off, and never walk up when his fury bar is high or his W is up. Give the wave if you must — you are looking to survive to 6, not win these levels.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are the scariest part of this lane and you simply lose them. Renekton dashes in with Slice and Dice, lands Ruthless Predator — an auto reset, so his wind-up is your cue, not the cast — and fury-empowers Cull the Meek to heal back anything you chip. Above 50 fury that stun runs 1.5s and breaks shields. Do not contest CS inside his range; last-hit at the edge of Radiant Blast, use W only to top off, and never walk up while his fury bar is high or his W is up. Give the wave if you must — you are surviving to 6, not winning these levels.
